results.content: The primary functions of the Coordinating Center are to: • coordinate observing programs approved by the Di-recting Board, • create and maintain the master schedule of observ-ing sessions in coordination with IVS Network Sta-tions and astronomical observing programs, • foster communications among all components of the IVS, • coordinate the best use of community resources, • develop standard procedures for IVS components, • organize training in VLBI techniques, • organize workshops and meetings, including IVS technical meetings, • produce and publish reports of activities of IVS components, • maintain the IVS information system and archive all documents, standards, specifications, manuals, reports, and publications, • coordinate IVS outreach and educational activities, • provide liaison with the IAU, IAG, GGOS, IERS, and other organizations, • provide the Secretariat of the Directing Board.
